source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: mailTabs.setQuickFilter normalizes a falsy text value to null before updating the search input and stored filter state. The text event handler uses the same null representation. Its UI test awaits the API call and directly checks null filter text against an empty input value. The separate visible-message helper waits for allMessagesLoaded: resolving setQuickFilter initiates the search but is not proof that result loading has finished. Focused nonempty input can still reject replacement and retain the old term. This is a checked source/test contract, not a reproduced intermittent result.
title: Normalize cleared quick-filter text before both UI and state updates
